newsitem.title: USA: Showboat shares rise on casino sale.
newsitem.headline: Showboat shares rise on casino sale.

text.p: Shares of Showboat Inc, a Las Vegas-based hotel and casino operator, rose three to 22-3/4 near the end of trading on Monday after the company on Sunday said it is selling part of its interest in the Sydney Harbour Casino in Sydney, Australia.
Financial analysts said the sale should give Showboat cash to expand operations in the United States either through a merger or acquisition.
"Showboat can (now) be perceived as a name to be taken very seriously," said David Liebowitz, analyst at Burnham Securities.

With the cost of developing huge hotels and casinos on the rise, mid-sized gambling concerns like Showboat need to merge or form joint ventures to compete with industry giants like Hilton Hotels Corp or Mirage Resorts Inc, analysts said.
Showboat sold a 10 percent stake in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Inc, owner of the casino, and 85 percent of the management contract to Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd for A$340 million.
Publishing and Broadcasting's major shareholder is Australian media mogul Kerry Packer.
